title: Tsukkomi Slam Telop
description: Câu chêm kiểu tsukkomi nghiêng −8° đập xuống từ cỡ to gấp rưỡi trong ba khung, cả khung hình rung mạnh tắt dần, các tia tập trung loé rồi mờ.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-telop-tsukkomi, written here): From 0.35 s: telop (44 px heavy, ink fill, accent outer stroke 0.32 em, dark (4, 4) px shadow) rotated −8°, scale 2.5 → 1 over 3 frames at 30 fps (0.1 s) power1.in. From impact the background shakes seeded ±12 px × (1 − k / 8) for 8 frames at 24 fps (the text moves half as much). 40 radial wedges (0.02–0.04 rad) from an inner ellipse 72–112 px (×0.7 vertically) to 230 px, re-jittered every 24 fps frame, 75 %, fading 0.1–0.5 s after impact. Off at 2.25 s. Loop 2.6 s. Params: tỉ lệ (250 % → 100 %, 3 khung) · góc (−8°) · rung (±12 px, 8 khung) · tia (40, mờ trong 0.4 s). Scale 2.5 → 1 in 3 frames (power1.in); the wedges re-jitter every 24 fps frame and fade 0.1–0.5 s after the hit.
